title: Associate QA Manual & Automation Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

**About the Role:**

  

We are looking for a Technical QA Engineer to help elevate the quality of platform and DevOps deliverables. This role focuses on validating technical, operational, and business-related capabilities delivered by platform engineering teams, ensuring that enhancements meet functional, operational, and customer usage expectations before they are released. The successful candidate will work closely with DevOps engineers, product owners, architects, developers, and stakeholders to define and execute meaningful test coverage. This is not limited to basic deployment verification; the role is intended to validate the actual behaviour, usability, integration, and readiness of DevOps deliverables across realistic product and customer scenarios.

The role is primarily manual QA. Exposure to scripting or automation is considered an advantage, with the potential to support future test coverage improvements where relevant.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan, design, and execute manual test scenarios for DevOps and platform deliverables, including both technical and business-oriented functionality.

* Validate application and platform behaviour across containerized environments and, where relevant, virtual machine-based environments.

* Perform end-to-end validation of Kubernetes-based deployments, Helm chart behaviour, configuration changes, upgrades, rollbacks, and release readiness activities.

* Test platform services and integrations involving Kafka, MQ, Elasticsearch, databases, APIs, logging, monitoring, and operational tooling.

* Validate deployment, scaling, resiliency, backup, recovery, failover, and day-2 operational workflows where applicable.

* Verify that platform deliverables support expected business/application flows, not only that the deployment technically completes.

* Review requirements, design notes, Jira items, and technical documentation to identify test impact, gaps, risks, and required clarifications.

* Create and maintain test cases, test evidence, defect documentation, and release-quality summaries.

* Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into practical test scenarios.

* Hands-on experience with API testing.

* Familiarity with containerized environments, preferably Kubernetes or OpenShift.

* Familiarity with messaging or event-streaming technologies such as Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, or similar.

* Exposure to search or indexing technologies such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.

* Experience validating integrations across applications, middleware, infrastructure, and platform services.

* Ability to troubleshoot complex workflows and collaborate effectively with DevOps, development, architecture, and product stakeholders.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Technical Ecosystem Area Relevant Exposure Platforms Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, Helm, containerized environments, VM-based environments CI/CD and release flow Azure DevOps, pipelines, deployment validation, upgrade and rollback checks Middleware and integrations Kafka, MQ, APIs, service integrations, asynchronous processing Data and search Relational databases, NoSQL databases, Elasticsearch or OpenSearch Observability Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, logging, monitoring, alerting, dashboards Cloud and infrastructure Azure cloud services, networking concepts, infrastructure configuration, platform services Scripting / automation advantage Python, Bash, JavaScript, API test tools, automation frameworks as an advantage Advantageous Skills

* Understanding of payment flows, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation, or related financial application concepts.

* Basic scripting experience using Python, Bash, JavaScript, or similar languages.

* Comfortable working in complex, distributed, and containerized environments.

* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, resiliency/security implications, and control expectations; ability to coach managers/leads and influence leaders on safe scaling patterns.
* Experience in software testing/quality engineering and in a leadership/management capacity (leading SDET/QE teams).
* Deep hands-on expertise with Rest Assured for API automation and Playwright for UI/E2E automation, with a track record of building frameworks at scale.
* Strong background in performance/load testing strategy and execution (JMeter), including capacity planning and production performance analysis.
* Demonstrated experience driving AI-enabled testing transformation — automation intelligence, GenAI copilots, or ML-based quality analytics. Proven track record building and scaling automation/performance frameworks across multiple teams or business units.
* Strong leadership skills — team building, mentoring, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD, DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), and microservices architecture.
* Experience presenting quality strategy and metrics to senior/executive leadership.
* Strong programming background (Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python) with the ability to contribute hands-on when needed.

* **Customer\-Driven Innovation:** We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers.
* **Agility in Action:** We embrace change and remain unified in our purpose and objectives.

  



We are looking for a **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** to drive quality engineering and automation across Securonix products, including **SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP)**, and associated cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities.

 **Role Overview:**

  

As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and end\-to\-end workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in **Python**, hands\-on experience with **Pytest and Playwright**, and a solid understanding of API and microservices testing. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using **Python and Pytest**.
* Build and maintain modern UI and end\-to\-end automation using **Playwright**.
* Develop automated test suites for API, UI, backend, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Drive an **API\-first automation strategy** for microservices and platform capabilities.
* Validate REST APIs, service\-to\-service integrations, authentication, data contracts, error handling, and distributed workflows.
* Validate data\-processing pipelines and data integrity using Python, SQL, and API\-based validation.
* Test complex workflows across Securonix products, including **SIEM and ThreatQ/TIP**.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, fixtures, test\-data management, and reporting capabilities.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable continuous testing.
* Analyze automation failures, application logs, API responses, and backend data to perform root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in design and architecture discussions to improve testability, observability, reliability, and product quality.
* Identify regression risks and ensure appropriate automated coverage for new features and production defect fixes.
* Mentor QA/SDET engineers on automation design, coding standards, debugging, and testing best practices.
* Explore AI\-assisted testing and automation to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection.

* **5–8 years** of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or SDET roles.
* Strong programming experience in **Python**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Pytest**, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework design.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Playwright** for UI and end\-to\-end automation.
* Strong experience in REST API automation and testing.
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks—not only individual test scripts.
* Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures.
* Experience with SQL and backend/data validation.
* Experience testing complex integration and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Good understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, debugging, logging, and defect\-management tools such as JIRA.
* Strong understanding of software\-testing principles, test\-design techniques, regression strategies, and Agile development practices.

  


**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
* Ability to take **end\-to\-end ownership of quality** for a feature or product area.
* Ability to understand complex product architectures and identify appropriate testing strategies.
* Strong collaboration skills for working with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams.
* Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering.

  


**Why Join Securonix?**

  

Work at the intersection of **cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large\-scale data platforms** while building quality\-engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. This role provides significant ownership of automation strategy and an opportunity to influence how quality is engineered across Securonix product lines.
